_about: BOW v2 STAGED DARK, UNPROVEN IN UNITY. Read by BowCfg.cs. Master 'enabled' false or a missing file = no bow anywhere, every fight is bit for bit today's (BowHooks returns neutral on its first line). Ported from Frankendom V3 / V1 sandbox rows (sandbox-rules-defs.json: missile, missileLanes, bowSpecial, specialPick; kit/source/v3_sandbox-rules-defs.json). V3 units kept where it can: speeds in cm/s, shares per-mille, ticks at 60 Hz. The bow is a MODE of the fighter, not a gear swap: mode ON = strikes become auto-aimed arrows (the shot always flies at the foe, only a roll i-frame, a guard that covers the lane, or a parry-less block answers it; V3 missileHoming 1), the two specials change to the bow's, WeaponHooks reports the bow weapon stats. Command line: -bow:on / -bow:off (force master), -bow:auto (force auto.enabled), -bow:log (one line per switch and shot).

auto._about: AUTO-SWITCH melee <-> bow by range (centre to centre, metres, horizontal). OFF by default (enabled false): the bow is then only reachable by the manual toggle key (input.toggleKeys) and only while the master is on. rangeEnterM > rangeExitM is the hysteresis: the bow comes out only after the foe has stayed at or beyond rangeEnterM for enterHoldTicks (and at most maxRangeM, 0 = controls.json camera.exitRange so the bow never fires past the lock-on), the sword comes back as soon as the foe is at or inside rangeExitM and the fighter is free. Melee engagement in this project is about 3.1-3.3 m (Duel.Resolve reach 1.65-2.0 x scale + both radii 0.4 + slack 0.45), so rangeExitM 5.0 leaves 1.7 m (about 0.3 s at run speed) to get the sword out. Switching only happens while FState.Loco and guard not held, so it can never cancel a swing, a roll, a stagger or a guard. guardExitsBow: raising the guard in bow mode drops to melee at once and locks the bow out for lockoutAfterGuardTicks. A manual toggle freezes the auto logic for manualHoldTicks. requireLockOn: only auto-switch while the combat camera is locked on. blockWhenGearWeapon: no bow mode while a gear weapon (maul, trident) is on the socket.

input._about: Manual toggle (works with auto off). Alpha3 = key 3 (1 / 2 are the specials; B is the riposte key in flow.json). KeyCode names; pad L3 = JoystickButton8 (A/B/R3 are dodge/riposte/lock, Y/X specials).

gearWeapon._about: WeaponHooks while the bow is up (replaces the sword's neutral 1/1/1/1). reachMul stays 1 so the AI's range reads of the player are unchanged (arrows ignore reach). speedMul 0.85 ~ V3 'windup 20 percent' (V3 added 20 percent to windup only; Unity scales every phase).

visual._about: BowVisual.cs: glb from gear.json items[].joan_bow (StreamingAssets/Gear/joan_bow_LOD0.glb = V1 bow-v1.glb, textures re-encoded PNG by BOWART v2). Parented to handRole of the fighter skeleton (Roster.BoneName). hold = Euler degrees + metres in the LeftHand bone frame of the 106-joint Mixamo rig, fitted by Tools/bow_clips_build.py on the bow_hold pose (BOWART v2: grip centre in the palm, long axis = the fist axis, string side to the archer; one static hold for every state: in non-bow poses the bow tilts with the hand).

arrow._about: Presentation only (no sim): V1 arrow model 0.95 m x 0.028 m, head/fin colours, shaders tried in order (first that exists), chest height m of the aim point and of the release point.
arrow.head: #8d9399

hud._about: OnGUI from BowHud (own host, not GameHUD): auto-aim brackets on the target while the bow is up, a mode chip (SWORD / BOW + arrows left when quiverOn) above the special icons.

aiAnswer._about: RESERVED, not read by C# in v1 (V3 missileAnswer 15/15/0). The enemy brain reacts to the shooter's Active frames like any attack; a seeded roll would move AiState.Roll and the balance baseline. Do not wire without a rebaseline.

clips._about: BOWART v2 documentation (not read by C#): Animator states baked into Joan_bow_v1.glb. loose/L/R = full shots (nock, draw, anchor, release, follow-through), contact time = the release; draw/hold have no move row.
